objective: Deepen independent evidence for five baseline finalists, all defensive concepts, and all tactical concepts without constructing or training a combined router.

measurements.baseline: state leaderboard, holdout recurrence, cost survival, default-baseline comparison
measurements.defensive: return and drawdown versus displaced baseline at 10 and 20 basis points
measurements.tactical: incremental return versus displaced baseline over 1, 2, 3, 5, and 10 sessions with causal state age and pending-transition diagnostics
